CustomObject.description: Published when an AI provider callout needs a retry with a fresh set of governor limits. Carries only the two Ids needed to redo the turn from scratch - AIMessageCalloutEventHandler enqueues AiMessageProcessingQueueable, which reloads the Agent/Model Configuration/Prompt Template/message history/tools from AIConversationMessageId__c and calls AiAgentOrchestrator.executeAiMessage again. No request/response state is carried on the event itself.
CustomObject.label: AI Message Callout Event
